Of the 40 laboratory-diagnosed dengue cases with available data, 22 (55%) were males.
States reporting the highest number of cases were Massachusetts (four) in 1999 and New York (five) in 2000.
The most commonly reported symptoms were fever (100%), headache (64%), rash (54%), and myalgia (39%).
